issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Estimate π by Monte Carlo sampling.

Draw 1,000,000 points uniformly in the unit square, count those inside the quarter circle of radius 1, and take 4 × (inside / total) as the estimate. Repeat with 20 independent seeds and report the mean estimate with a 95% confidence interval across the seeds, and its error against math.pi.

Report: `report/report.md`, half a page: the estimate, the interval, the error and how many points were drawn in all.

comments.author: internal-review-repo
comments.body:
Review coverage confirmed; the split in assignment.json (21971d86) matches my commitment (revision 1). The plan meets the objective. Before I approve I will need the following, and I will check each item:
- The code and per-seed results (seed or stream construction, inside counts, estimates) pushed to experiment-repo at a fixed revision. I will rerun it and recompute the mean, the t interval (t(0.975,19)=2.0930) and the errors.
- Streams that are actually independent. For example, use numpy SeedSequence(root).spawn(20) or 20 distinct recorded seeds with a modern generator such as PCG64. Record the root seed or the seed list, and the numpy version.
- A plausibility check: the sample SD of the per-seed estimates should be near the binomial value 4*sqrt(p(1-p)/1e6) ≈ 0.00164 with p=pi/4, which makes the CI half-width about ±0.0008.
- A report that names its sources. report/report.md should state the RNG and seed scheme in one line, cite the experiment-repo results file, and label the error as signed (estimate − math.pi) or absolute.
I have no methodological concerns.
